name: Khajiit god-strength and Lattice Resonance
publicLanguage: Name only the current god as being in strength. Do not describe ordinary waxing or waning.
cycle: Eight slots over Skyrim's 24-day visible lunar cycle, scheduled at the next game-time slot boundary.

retired.policy: Keep legacy records for FormID and save compatibility, never grant them, remove lingering instances during reconciliation, and apply no presiding-deity multiplier in the piety pipeline.

resonance.condition: Khajiit origin, a focused deity at Seeker or above, and focused deity equals the god in strength.
resonance.coverage: All fifteen focused blessing spells and no substrate or scripted capstone records.
resonance.entryPoint: Mod Spell Magnitude; Multiply 1.20; spell has the focused-blessing keyword.
resonance.refresh: Remove and re-add the current constant-effect focus reward whenever resonance state changes.

observations.selection: Uniform random selection from the ten lines for the current god plus the six shared lines, with resolved-ID immediate-repeat rejection across god changes.
observations.fallback: Use the existing compiled four-line deity set when the JSON is missing or invalid.
